title: Skill frontmatter
description: Structural shape of the YAML frontmatter every SKILL.md must carry. Membership checks against the controlled vocabularies (category, stage, io_types) and semantic checks (trigger-phrased description, evidence base, dangling inputs, atomicity) live in scripts/validate.js against schema/taxonomy.yaml, not here.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match the skill's folder name.

title.description: Human-readable name shown in the catalogue.

description.description: Trigger conditions for invoking this skill, not a summary of what it does. Should read as 'Use when...' / 'Invoke when...', naming the user intent or input state that fires it.

category.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#categories.

stage.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#stages.

url.description: Link to the paper or framework. Must be http(s) — this renders as a clickable link on the site.

type.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#io_types.

source.description: 'user' means a human supplies it directly; 'skill-output' means it's expected to come from another skill's output.

type.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#io_types.
